sourceHeader.time: Special, as part of casting an Akimichi Hijutsu that makes a melee attack.

castOptions.label: Pay with Calories (1)
castOptions.note: Cast it for 1 Calories instead of chakra (its upcast may add Calories: spend them by hand).

castOptions.label: Expansion Crash
castOptions.note: In your Expansion Technique stance: add your proficiency bonus to the check.

system.description:
An Akimichi secret maneuver allowing you to take a nature release you are encountering or clashing with, and turning it against your foes.

When the triggering Akimichi Hijutsu would allow you to make a melee attack against a hostile creature under the effects of, or clash with, a jutsu with a nature release keyword. Make a Contested Strength or Constitution ability check, vs the targets Jutsu save DC. On a success, you Dispel their jutsu’s effects. If they are under the effects of two or more jutsu with a nature release keyword, dispel the oldest, or highest rank one, otherwise, choose at random.

Expansion Crash. Add your proficiency bonus to the contested check.

source.custom: Source Markdown line 749; contextual rules require adjudication.

roll.note: With an Akimichi Hijutsu's melee attack on a creature under (or clashing with) a nature release jutsu: a Strength or Constitution check against its jutsu save DC; success dispels it (the oldest or highest rank of several).
